summary: Full E2E testing of Cox Junk Removal marketing site. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (root message, POST happy path, blank-required 400, 5 missing-field 422 cases, GET list sort + no _id). Minor gap; Pydantic enforces presence but allows whitespace-only service_type/description. Consider strengthening backend check.
ServiceArea.jsx 'contact' section data-testid='contact-section' is good; phone display uses <wbr> which is fine. No accessibility issues observed.
Files are well under 700 lines, env vars used correctly, no MongoDB _id leakage, async used throughout.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ created in quote_requests collection via API and UI submission.
